title: helianthemum virgatum var. strictum
intro: Helianthemum virgatum var. strictum, commonly known as Rockrose or Strict Rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant's health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage.
